record.question: Olive oil is used in cosmetic preparations because:
options: It has a very potent antimicrobial & wound healing property
It contains oleic acid which is beneficial for hydration
It has record of high patient compliance due to quick evaporation
It contains folic acid which helps in circulation
record.explanation: Answer B: It contains oleic acid which is beneficial for hydration. Olive oil is rich in oleic acid, a fatty acid that acts as an emollient and can support skin hydration. Source/context note: Effect depends on formulation; this is not a claim of a therapeutic wound-healing effect. Reference: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/Oleic-Acid. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
